source_selection: last 10 nonempty JSONL records per worker score input
notes: Offline assessment from supplied packets only. No web research, keyword templates, inferred facts, or decimal jitter. No composite scores.

method: Manual reassessment of each packet against rubric harm and affected-population definitions; original results preserved.
key_adjustments: Removed harm scores for clemency relief and court rulings; removed reach based solely on speech attention; set institutional damage to zero for oversight, criticism, dismissal, and unresolved statements unless packet documents damage.
ambiguities: Reach may reflect national policy scope where a proposal/tool directly governs a national system, but not merely the audience of remarks. Temporary stays and proposals create potential exposure distinct from realized harm.
